title: Improving Reliability of Bukit Panjang LRT System
what_it_is: Improving Reliability of Bukit Panjang LRT System

sections.label: BPLRT power faults and renewal
sections.summary: BPLRT is nearing the end of its design life, most disruptions were power-related, and LTA and SMRT are checking power rails, replacing hotspots and adding a Ten Mile Junction back-up power source by year end.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The system is nearing the end of its design life and is due for renewal.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Most of the disruptions on BPLRT have been due to power-related faults.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: In the immediate term, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) and Singapore Mass Rapid Transit (SMRT) are carrying out detailed checks of the Light Rail Transit's (LRT's) power rails and performing hotspot replacement works where needed.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: LTA will also install a new power source at the Ten Mile Junction substation to provide a back-up to the existing system at Choa Chu Kang.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Both exercises will be completed by year end.

sections.label: SMRT quick response team, renewal contract
sections.summary: SMRT is forming a quick response team to rectify train faults and shorten service recovery times, and LTA will award a BPLRT renewal contract in the first half of 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: In addition, SMRT is forming a quick response team to rectify train faults and shorten service recovery times.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: In the first half of 2018, LTA will be awarding a contract to renew BPLRT.

sections.label: Breakdown plans and Yishun LRT
sections.summary: A Member asked what plans the Ministry has to reduce the breakdown rate, and the Ministry said the LRT is not in the works for Yishun Town.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: What plans does the Ministry have to reduce the breakdown rate because, recently, there are still a lot of breakdowns?

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: I regret to inform the hon Member that the LRT is not in the works for Yishun Town.
